title: Validation errors point at the field
note: RFC 9457 problem details with RFC 6901 JSON Pointers. Unknown fields are rejected, not ignored.

note: Private, loopback and link-local targets are refused at validation, and again at DNS resolution time for hostnames.
request:
POST /v1/monitors HTTP/1.1
accept: application/json
content-type: application/json
authorization: Bearer <AHM_API_KEY>

{
  "name": "metadata",
  "url": "http://169.254.169.254/latest/meta-data/"
}
